what_happened: The job to add per-reader worktree and fallback tests for the records branch move (D111) failed in planning. After three rounds the critic still wanted the plan revised. Most of the plan checked out: every reader was classified, there is one place in paths.rs that picks where records are read from, and the scan, scoring and status tests were sound. One major finding remained. The plan puts the xtask walltime reader's test in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs, but xtask has no library target and athena-cli does not depend on it, so that test cannot be written there. A minor finding said the plan does not state what the land_pr, audit, auditor and status tests observe to tell the worktree record from the in-tree one. A nit said decision 2 describes a fault that is not in this snapshot. No code was written.
cause: Planning checks that named files exist, but not that the chosen test location can reach the code under test. Crate boundaries, library targets and dependencies are not part of the plan check, and the planner is not made to say what each test observes. A single shared test file with one macro for all readers hid the fact that one reader sits in a different crate. The critic found the gap only in the last round, and the planner had no round left to fix it.
prevention: Add a plan check before the critic rounds. For each demonstration, it resolves the test file's crate and the target's crate, and confirms the target is reachable: the same crate, a declared dependency, or a library target. If it is not, the plan is sent back with that finding on round 1. The planner template should also require each per-item test to state what it observes, so gaps like the one for land_pr, audit and status show up at once.
proposed_request: Add per-reader tests for the records branch move (D111), showing for each reader that it reads the worktree record when present and falls back to the in-tree record otherwise. Cover the readers in athena-cli in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs. For the xtask walltime reader, which has no library target and is not a dependency of athena-cli, place its worktree and fallback pair inside xtask itself (unit tests or xtask/tests), or state another way to exercise it. For land_pr, audit, auditor and status, say what each test observes to tell the worktree record from the in-tree one (for example a planted marker value in each). land_pr's test helpers are private to gh.rs, so either test it in gh.rs or expose them for tests. Acceptance: every reader has a worktree test and a fallback test that pass, scoring is documented as using the worktree regardless of the head passed, the scan has a planted-read test, and the full test suite passes.
